body: BasisId review addendum answering your three explicit questions: (1) a basis difference forces a FeatureSpaceId difference through outputSpaceId(basis), and both Aggregate and Windowed production constructors use that overload; it is not merely adjacent provenance. (2) the expected BasisId and output-space values are fixed hex literals. I independently recomputed both SHA-256 values outside production and matched 08a021d6... and 0ea2b30c...; reversing/composition changes are asserted separately. (3) ADR 0003 was considered and is INAPPLICABLE here: this slice publishes deterministic identity/provenance hashes, not a subject measurement, score, proportion, support mass, interval, or hard classification. Coverage and Estimate values pass through unchanged; no numeric estimand or support figure is introduced or transformed.
